note: Stretch and mobility library for Ironlog — the mobility counterpart of exercises.json. One record per stretch or drill; routines (r&d/data/routines/) pick from it. Ids are permanent: routine ticks key on them, and the items of the built-in Full Body Stretch keep their routine ids here (inRoutine). Doses are defaults a routine may override: hold (s), holdRange, reps, sets, perSide, positions, then — the same fields as a routine item (r&d/specs/mobility-spec.md). style: static = passive hold; active = held or moved by the lifter's own muscles; dynamic = moving through range; pnf = contract-relax; loaded = strength at length with a weight or band; release = foam roller, ball or gun. endRange:true marks passive end-range work the hypermobility rule says to go easy on; swap names an active or loaded alternative in this library. joints use the Go easy on vocabulary (MOB_JOINTS in js/health.js). Source: r&d/notes/master-catalogue-research.md §20.

items.name: Neck Side Tilt
items.cue: Sit tall. Ear toward shoulder, let gravity do it — no pulling with the hands. Switch sides.

items.name: Neck Rotation
items.cue: Chin level, rotate to look over each shoulder. Hold at end range without forcing.

items.name: Chin Tuck
items.cue: Draw the chin straight back (not down). Hold 5 s, release.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cue: Inhale into cow, exhale into cat. Slowly, one vertebra at a time.

items.name: Thoracic Extension over Rolled Towel
items.cue: Towel or foam roller across the upper back at the apex of the curve. Arms crossed or overhead. Move it up and down in small steps.

items.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
items.cue: Forearms on the frame at 90°, step through. Chin tucked. Try low, mid and high arm heights.

items.name: Thread the Needle
items.cue: Slide one arm under the body, rotate until the shoulder meets the floor. Breathe, switch.

items.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
items.cue: Pull the arm across with the other hand at the elbow. Keep the shoulder down.

items.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
items.cue: Hand behind head, other hand eases the elbow back. Ribs down.

items.name: Wrist Flexor & Extensor Stretch
items.cue: Arm out in front. Flexors: pull the fingers back. Extensors: push the fingers down. Both sides.

items.name: Supine Knee-to-Chest
items.cue: One knee in, other leg flat. Then both knees together, rock gently side to side.

items.name: Supine Spinal Twist
items.cue: Knee across the body, opposite arm out flat. Look away from the knee. Don't force the knee down.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.cue: Hips back to heels, arms forward. Walk the hands to each side for the lats.

items.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Lunge
items.cue: Back knee down, hips forward gently, torso upright, slight posterior pelvic tilt.

items.name: Pigeon Pose (modified)
items.cue: Shin forward across the body, hips sink toward the floor, hands support. If too intense, do a lying glute stretch instead.

items.name: Butterfly Stretch
items.cue: Soles together, sit tall, elbows ease the knees down. Heels closer = more intense.

items.name: Deep Squat Hold
items.cue: Shoulder-width, toes slightly out, as deep as possible. Hold a doorframe or pole if needed. Elbows press knees out.

items.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
items.cue: Hold behind the thigh or calf, not the knee. Straighten as far as it goes; flex the foot for the calf.

items.name: Standing Forward Fold (progressive)
items.cue: Feet together, hang. Each exhale, straighten the legs a little more.

items.name: Seated Single-Leg Forward Fold
items.cue: One leg straight, other bent in. Reach toward the foot without rounding the lower back to cheat.

items.name: Standing Quad Stretch
items.cue: Foot to glute, knees together, stand tall. Use the wall — hypermobility.

items.name: Prone Quad Stretch
items.cue: Face down, pull one foot toward the glute. Hips stay down.

items.name: Standing Calf Stretch
items.cue: Back leg straight, heel down throughout.

items.name: Bent-Knee Calf Stretch
items.cue: Same position, back knee slightly bent — shifts it to the soleus.

items.name: Ankle Circles & Toe Spreads
items.cue: Circle each ankle slowly both ways, then spread the toes wide and relax them.

items.name: Upper Trap Stretch
items.cue: Sit on one hand to pin the shoulder, ear to the other shoulder, light hand on the head.

items.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
items.cue: Turn the nose toward the armpit and let the head drop forward.

items.name: Neck CARs
items.cue: Slow, controlled full circles of the head, tall posture, no forcing the end range.

items.name: Sleeper Stretch
items.cue: Lie on the side, arm at 90 degrees, gently press the forearm toward the floor.

items.name: Lat Stretch on Rack
items.cue: Hold an upright, sit the hips back and away until the side of the back opens.

items.name: Band Dislocates
items.cue: Wide grip on a band or PVC, straight arms over and behind, then back. Narrow the grip slowly over weeks.

items.name: Shoulder CARs
items.cue: Biggest slow circle the arm can make with the ribs kept down. Reverse.

items.name: Arm Circles
items.cue: Small to big circles forwards, then backwards.

items.name: End-Range External Rotation Hold
items.cue: Light band, elbow at 90 degrees, rotate out to the end you control and hold. Active alternative to the sleeper stretch.

items.name: Prone Swimmers
items.cue: Face down, hands off the floor, sweep from overhead to the low back and return.

items.name: Pec Minor Stretch
items.cue: Hand high on the doorframe, turn the chest away, shoulder blade back and down.

items.name: Contract-Relax Pec Stretch
items.cue: In the doorway stretch, press the forearm into the frame for 5 s, relax, step a little further. Three rounds.

items.name: Open Books
items.cue: Side-lying, knees stacked at 90 degrees, rotate the top arm open and follow it with the eyes.

items.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
items.cue: Roller across the mid back, hands behind the head, extend over it, move up a segment, repeat.

items.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
items.cue: On all fours, hand behind the head, rotate the elbow down then up to the ceiling. Hips stay still.

items.name: Child's Pose Side Reach
items.cue: In child's pose, walk both hands to one side.

items.name: Cobra
items.cue: Face down, press up through the hands, hips stay on the floor.

items.name: Segmental Roll-Down
items.cue: Standing, chin to chest and roll down one vertebra at a time, then roll back up.

items.name: Bar Hang
items.cue: Hang from a bar with the legs relaxed. Feet on a box to take some weight if needed.

items.name: Standing Side Bend Stretch
items.cue: Arm overhead, reach up and over to the side without leaning forward.

items.name: Wrist Circles
items.cue: Fingers laced, slow full circles both ways.

items.name: Kneeling Wrist Stretch
items.cue: On all fours, fingers forward, then back toward the knees, then palms up. Rock gently.

items.name: Prayer Stretch
items.cue: Palms together at the chest, lower the hands until the wrists stretch. Then reverse prayer.

items.name: Couch Stretch
items.cue: Back knee on the floor against the wall, shin up the wall, front foot forward, squeeze the glute.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
items.cue: Both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side. Sit tall, lean over the front shin.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cue: From 90/90, lift both knees and rotate to the other side. Hands behind or off the floor.

items.name: Frog Stretch
items.cue: All fours, knees wide, ankles in line with the knees, rock the hips back.

items.name: Figure-4 Stretch
items.cue: On the back, ankle across the other knee, pull the bottom thigh in.

items.name: Seated Straddle
items.cue: Legs wide, sit tall and hinge forward from the hips.

items.name: Adductor Rock-Back
items.cue: On all fours with one leg out to the side, rock the hips back and forward.

items.name: Leg Swings (front–back)
items.cue: Hold a support, swing one leg forward and back, growing the range.

items.name: Leg Swings (side to side)
items.cue: Face a support, swing the leg across the body and out.

items.name: Hip CARs
items.cue: On all fours or standing, draw the biggest slow circle with the knee without the pelvis moving.

items.name: World's Greatest Stretch
items.cue: Lunge, elbow to the inside of the front foot, rotate that arm to the ceiling, then straighten the front leg.

items.name: Spiderman Lunge
items.cue: Step into a deep lunge with the foot outside the hand, sink, switch.

items.name: Lunge with Rotation
items.cue: Step into a lunge and rotate the chest over the front leg.

items.name: Cossack Shift
items.cue: Wide stance, shift into one deep side squat with the other leg straight, toes up. Shift across.

items.name: Pancake
items.cue: Straddle sit, hinge forward with a flat back, chest toward the floor.

items.name: Straddle Good Morning
items.cue: Wide stance, light bar or plate, hinge to a stretch with a flat back, pause, stand.

items.name: Front Split
items.cue: Blocks under the hands, slide toward the floor only as far as stays square.

items.name: Middle Split
items.cue: Hands on blocks, feet slide out, hips stay over the feet.

items.name: Inchworm
items.cue: Fold to the floor, walk the hands out to a plank, walk the feet in.

items.name: Frankenstein Kicks
items.cue: Walk forward kicking a straight leg up to the opposite hand.

items.name: Banded Hamstring Floss
items.cue: On the back with a strap on the foot, straighten and bend the knee slowly. Point and flex the foot.

items.name: Contract-Relax Hamstring Stretch
items.cue: Strap on the foot, press the leg into the strap for 5 s, relax, pull a little further. Three rounds.

items.name: Standing Toe Touch
items.cue: Feet together, soft knees, fold and let the head hang.

items.name: Loaded RDL Stretch
items.cue: Light weight, slow lowering to a hamstring stretch, 2 s pause, stand. Strength at length.

items.name: Heel-to-Butt Walk
items.cue: Walk, pulling one heel to the glute each step.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.cue: Jog on the spot kicking the heels to the glutes.

items.name: Kneeling Quad Rock-Back
items.cue: Kneel tall, lean back from the knees with the hips straight, come back up.

items.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Rock
items.cue: Foot a few cm from the wall, drive the knee to the wall without the heel lifting. Move back as it gets easy.

items.name: Step Calf Drop
items.cue: Balls of the feet on a step, let the heels sink.

items.name: Banded Ankle Distraction
items.cue: Band low around the front of the ankle pulling back, lunge the knee forward over the toes.

items.name: Loaded Ankle Rock
items.cue: Half-kneeling, weight on the front knee, rock the knee forward past the toes.

items.name: Kneeling Shin Stretch
items.cue: Kneel on the tops of the feet and sit back toward the heels.

items.name: Ankle ABCs
items.cue: Leg out, trace the alphabet with the big toe.

items.name: Downward Dog
items.cue: Hips high, push the floor away, heels toward the floor. Pedal the feet.

items.name: Low Lunge
items.cue: Back knee down, front shin vertical, hips forward, arms up.

items.name: Warrior Series
items.cue: Flow warrior one, two and reverse warrior on each side.

items.name: Sun Salutation
items.cue: Reach up, fold, half lift, plank, cobra, downward dog, step forward, rise. One breath per move.

items.name: Back Bridge
items.cue: From the back, hands by the ears, press up into a full bridge. Glute bridge or wall walk-down to scale.

items.name: Squat Pry
items.cue: In a supported deep squat, elbows push the knees out, shift side to side.

items.name: Foam Roll Quads
items.cue: Face down on the roller, slow passes hip to knee, pause on tight spots.

items.name: Foam Roll Outer Thigh
items.cue: Side-lying on the roller, top foot down to control pressure.

items.name: Foam Roll Upper Back
items.cue: Roller across the upper back, arms crossed, roll shoulder blades to mid back.

items.name: Foam Roll Lats
items.cue: Side-lying, arm overhead, roll from armpit to ribs.

items.name: Foam Roll Calves
items.cue: Calf on the roller, other leg on top for pressure, rotate the foot in and out.

items.name: Ball Release Glutes
items.cue: Sit on a lacrosse or massage ball, cross the ankle over the knee, hunt the tight spot.

items.name: Ball Release Pecs
items.cue: Ball between the chest and a wall, small circles below the collarbone.

items.name: Ball Release Feet
items.cue: Roll the sole slowly over a ball, heel to toes.

items.name: Massage Gun
items.cue: Short passes on the muscle belly, away from bone and the front of the neck.

items.name: Side Bridge (McGill)
items.cue: Short-lever side plank on the knees or full, held for short sets.

items.name: Pendulum Swings
items.cue: Lean on a bench, let the arm hang and swing small circles from the body.

items.name: Stick External Rotation
items.cue: Elbows at the sides, stick in both hands, push one hand out with the other.

items.name: Toe Yoga
items.cue: Lift the big toe with the others down, then the reverse.

items.name: Heel Walks
items.cue: Walk on the heels with the toes up.
